title: Convenient But Needs Improvement: A Review of eSewa App for iPad
review_text: eSewa is undoubtedly a convenient app for managing finances and making payments seamlessly. However, the iPad version falls short when it comes to entering the PIN number while making payments. Despite its user-friendly interface and array of features, this particular issue significantly hampers the overall user experience.  The app’s interface is sleek and intuitive, making navigation a breeze. From checking account balances to transferring funds, eSewa offers a plethora of functionalities, catering to various financial needs. Additionally, its integration with various merchants and service providers enhances its utility, allowing users to make payments for a wide range of services with just a few taps.  However, the inability to enter the PIN number while making payments from an iPad is a glaring flaw. This limitation not only disrupts the payment process but also undermines the security aspect of the app. Without the ability to input the PIN number, users are left vulnerable to unauthorized transactions, posing a significant awkwardness when comes to payment. I should have to try again and again in front of other party.   eSewa offers convenience and functionality, the inability to enter the PIN number on iPad devices is a notable drawback. Nonetheless, with further development and attention to user feedback, eSewa has the opportunity to solidify its position as a leading financial app in the market.
